docs: Payload CMS with the ShipKit collections (Pages, Media, Users, FAQs, Features, Testimonials, RBAC, VercelDeployments) and the Settings global. Admin UI at `/cms`, API at `/cms-api`. Set `DATABASE_URL` and `PAYLOAD_SECRET` (`PAYLOAD_PUBLIC_DRAFT_SECRET` enables draft preview). Overwrites the Bones stubs `src/payload.config.ts`, `src/lib/payload/payload.ts`, `src/lib/utils/get-payload-content.ts` and `src/payload-types.ts`; run with --overwrite. Needs `"@payload-config": ["./src/payload.config.ts"]` in tsconfig `paths` (Bones already has it) and `src/config/nextjs/with-payload.ts` is auto-loaded by Bones' Next.js plugin loader. After install run `pnpm payload generate:types`. Tables are created with the `shipkit_` prefix, so keep `DB_PREFIX=shipkit`.
